headline: 6 Prospective Issuers Queue for IPO, 2 Companies Get Massive Oversubscription
summary: The Indonesia Stock Exchange recorded six companies ready for IPOs, four of them mid-sized. Basic materials and healthcare dominate the queue.
why: The IPO pipeline shows future listings and capital raising on the Indonesia Stock Exchange, which affects market supply and sector exposure.
original_headline: 6 Calon Emiten Antre IPO, 2 Perusahaan Beraset Jumbo
